prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Caesium (Cs) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a city rooftop party under string lights
Time of day: night under neon and signage light, coloured reflections.
Light direction: side light — the light falls from one side, the far side of her face in soft shadow.
Outfit: a tight tube top under an open cropped cardigan with glossy high-waisted leggings that outline the hips and legs — in a soft pastel palette such as powder pink, baby blue, mint or lavender; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; fabric weight — its knit or thin-fabric pieces (a top, an inner top or a knit dress) are 60-denier yarn, semi-sheer so her skin tone and body line show softly through, with a fully opaque lining over the bust and the hips; any tights or stockings are sheer 40-denier nylon; shorts, skirts, leather, denim and other heavy materials stay opaque, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: walking.
COMPOSITION: an environmental long shot, her complete figure and enough of the place around her; back to the camera; camera at her eye level; she is small in the lower part of the frame, the place rising above her; the space runs far back behind her, its lines receding into the distance.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left arm hangs relaxed at her side.
PROP: with her own right hand she carries a small sealed glass ampoule holding a bead of soft pale-gold metal low at her side; it is all she holds.
LEGS: mid-stride, one heel lifting.
GAZE: she looks toward the far distance.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — caesium: a soft, pale-gold alkali metal that melts in a warm hand at about 28 degrees and explodes on touching water, the most violently reactive of the stable alkali metals, so it is kept sealed in glass ampoules under inert gas; found in 1860 in boiled-down spring water, the first element ever discovered with the spectroscope, and named from Latin caesius, sky blue, for the two bright blue lines in its flame; since 1967 the second is defined as 9,192,631,770 vibrations of the caesium atom, counted by atomic clocks — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
acceptance: user chose 1,1,1 and authorized main publication

observations: Original verified 1024x1536; one adult woman in focus; reference face/hair colour and painterly rendering followed.
Two attached arms and legs, both feet visible.
Frontal three-quarter pose instead of planned rear-facing walk; preserved.
qa.cause: Generation departed from a planned prop, pose, costume or text constraint; original preserved without regeneration.
